Welcome...I bet you're not here for shopping\ntoday, are you?\nIt's okay, we'll have a little chat.
By the way, that lil' merchant girl with you is\nreally something. She's still young, but so good\nat haggling. I bet even my friends can't beat her.
Well, she's always so calculating, but I feel like\nshe's got the skill to turn the tables whenever\nshe's about to take a beating.
Oh, I recall she has a huge hammer with her tho...\nWhaaat?! She brutally hits monsters with it?!\nNo way, what a fierce merchant warrior! Hahaha.
Uh? A blacksmith?! You must be kiddin'!\nHow could there be one here!\nYou need to deal with fire to be a blacksmith!!
...Sorry, but we're Eumanos. We'll instantly turn\ninto ashes when exposed to fire, so there's no\nblacksmith here. Sorry for that.
Hey, welcome! What do you need today?\nI'd not say I have plenty, but I do have most\nitems in stock, so take your time.
Aight, thank you!\nCome anytime if you need something again!\nI'll be waiting!
Oh! So you're that weird Sapien?\nI see. You've got no leaves and buds.\nYou don't have gills or fins either...
Where do you come from?\nWhat...? Another world?!\nThat's again...way beyond my imagination.
...Uh? Do I already know about you?\nYeah, we Eumanos are connected with the trees and\nflowers in the forest.
As soon as you set foot in this forest,\nthe news about a weird Sapien coming reached us.\nEverybody knows about it.
Anyway, isn't it inconvenient for you to not have\nleaves? I bet it's tough as you can't absorb light\nto make nutrients...Stay strong to survive, okay?
You're the visitor from another world, right?\nWelcome to Erva Tronc!\nIt's the largest town around here.
It's not that big, but there are some shops.\nSome brave soldiers are working to strengthen the\ntown's security...
There are also a few villages besides this town.\nAs buildings are being built while developing\nthem, they lack security...
Even under normal circumstances, vicious beasts\ncan be seen roaming around and there could be\nattacks by violent dragons...
Oh, the visitor from the outside world, what's up?\n...Me? I'm free so I was just daydreaming.\nMonster and dragon's attacks are rarely seen here.
By the way, rumor has it that a shadow that looks\nlike a Sapien, but somewhat different, was seen\nnear the volcano that is a little far from here...
Did you happen to go near the volca...\nOh, so you didn't? It's unlikely for a Rana that\nlives in water to climb it either. I wonder...
Uh oh...oh dear, sorry, that was a strange thing\nto say. Try checking it out if you ever go to\nthe volcano. No need to go there on purpose.
Excuse me, but could you possibly be...the person\nthat saved Master Arbol from danger?\nI knew it! Thank you very much!
Master Arbol has been a guru that taught me a lot.\nEven after attaching his roots to the ground, I\noccasionally visit him to learn various things.
I was so worried when I heard that he got injured\nfrom shielding the town from the dragon's attack.\nAnd I'm so thankful that you got him some meds...
Oh, it's the visitor. Are you observing the town?\n...Uh? The situation around this town? No imminent\nor big danger in particular I guess...
Attacks by a dragon like the one you beat or the\nbeasts around the town that have turned violent\nrecently, and also cases where the ancestrees
who are shielding the town get defeated are\ngetting more and more common though. We were also\ntold to think of a countermeasure...

A Lixi?!
It's a Lixi!!
He's a bringing a Lixi here! Is that okay?!
Aye~, it's sorta difficult to walk on the road\nhere because it's soft.
It is soft and difficult to walk on indeed...
Hahaha. I see, so it's difficult for you guys to\nwalk on. We make it soft so that we can absorb the\nnutrients in the soil with our feet.
Aye~! Your roots are your feet!\nSo you don't eat with your mouth?
Sometimes we do too. For example when we travel to\nplaces with a barren land or a rocky area because\nwe can't get nutrients from the soil...
Ayeee! Peluluuu!!
Ooh, where have you been!
T-t-that's because I know you won't die that\neasily. And I also know that you would come back\nafter finding Anono...
I'm glad you came.\nBefore you got here that kid was constantly grumpy\nand sour...
Pelulu, were you lonely when the adventurer and I\nwere not around? Lemme guess, you were, right?\nC'mon, don't be shy! Just admit it~!
S-shut up and go away!! Besides, I don't know\nwhere you learned to speak like that, it's so\nannoying, please stop!
As usual, she doesn't wanna be upfront...Besides,\nshe doesn't seem to realize that "Anono" sounds\njust like her...
Neither Kunon nor the ark is in sight...
Uh, uhm, go to the center of the town!\nShe's at the leader's house.
Your friend is odd...\nWell, let me guide you to the leader's house then.\nThis way...
Hey, look!\nMuti has become a Sproutling!!
How is it possible?!\nHe seems to be the least likely to turn into a\n"Sproutling"!!
I'm glad both of you are okay!
Muti! How is your wound?
Thanks to Menberg's ointment, it's all good now.\nPeople will even think that I'm lying if I tell\nthem about that horrible burn.
Who's that guy?
He looks like a dragon, but at the same time he\nalso looks like a human...
Well, I don't really care...
Listen up, everyone! He's a warrior of the species\ncalled weredragon living in the world under the\nforest we live in!
He was fighting to protect us from Coenubias!!
That's right! And not only Coenubias, but he's\nalso fought evil dragons, you know!
Oh really...?
Wow, he's amazing!
